verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports show RCLI can be installed through Homebrew, a standard package manager. One user found that not everything loads properly after a Homebrew install (comm-4). Another notes the install script silently installs Homebrew itself (comm-9). A third says no install method they tried worked (comm-14). Missing for 10: first-party docs naming a package-manager install path (brew/npm/pip/SPM/Gradle coordinates), evidence that the Homebrew install works reliably, and coverage for the SDK bindings beyond the CLI.
